description: Search published online memorials for people and pets by name. Newest first. Returns dates, the funeral home if there is one, and a link to each memorial.

region.description: "au" for Australia (foreverinourhearts.com.au), "global" for every other country (foreverinourhearts.co). Omit to search both

type.description: Memorials for people or for pets. Omit for both
